evals.prompt: Clone https://example.com as faithfully as possible. Keep the work resumable and tell me where you need confirmation before coding.
evals.expected_output: A thin orchestration plan that routes to extraction first, stops for canonical evidence approval, then routes to build and measurable QA.
assertions: Routes rendered evidence gathering through clone-website-extract-dl before implementation.
Includes a STOP for user confirmation after the canonical source of truth is ready.
Routes implementation through clone-website-build-dl and fidelity measurement through clone-website-qa-dl.
Uses an evidence-first repair loop when QA finds a mismatch.

evals.prompt: Clone just the pricing section from https://example.com/pricing and give me a reusable standalone React component.
evals.expected_output: A partial-clone route with focused responsive evidence, screenshot confirmation, standalone component props, skipped page assembly, and standalone QA.
assertions: Uses the partial clone route instead of full-page topology work.
Captures desktop and mobile section evidence and asks the user to confirm the selected section.
Builds one standalone component with props and defaults.
Skips full page assembly and still performs visual QA.

evals.prompt: The clone is close, but the original hero artwork is missing and the mobile spacing is wrong. Fix it and call it done when it matches.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-first repair route that records the discrepancy, re-extracts media and spacing evidence, updates the canonical record and specs, repairs implementation, and reruns measurable QA.
assertions: Does not patch implementation before updating live evidence and the canonical source of truth.
Uses the extraction skill to recover media and spacing evidence.
Requires reachable media to render or a documented booth fallback.
Reruns build and measurable QA before claiming completion.
